items.title: Agent Goal Hijack
items.summary: Malicious content in documents, tools or data redirects an agent's goals or decision path.

items.title: Tool Misuse and Exploitation
items.summary: An agent uses legitimate tools in unsafe or unauthorised ways, often through manipulated inputs.

items.title: Identity and Privilege Abuse
items.summary: Agents inherit, escalate or misuse identities, credentials and delegated privileges.

items.title: Agentic Supply Chain Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Compromised tools, plugins, prompts, MCP servers or other agents are pulled into the agent at runtime.

items.title: Unexpected Code Execution
items.summary: Agents generate or run code or commands that lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Memory and Context Poisoning
items.summary: Attackers corrupt an agent's memory, context or retrieved knowledge to influence later actions.

items.title: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication
items.summary: Messages between agents lack authentication, integrity or validation.

items.title: Cascading Failures
items.summary: A single fault or compromise propagates through connected agents and workflows.

items.title: Human-Agent Trust Exploitation
items.summary: Agents exploit or are used to exploit human trust, for example persuading users to approve harmful actions.

items.title: Rogue Agents
items.summary: Compromised or misaligned agents act outside their intended scope.
